firstTarget: KOLEKSIYON single-cell and affected-group mutation/persistence, not withCpBulkDraft

identity.actor: server/current-session verified actor; client hint never grants access
identity.workspaceOwnerId: captured Collection owner; never infer from CP buyer or array ordinal
identity.view: editable single-owner context; read-only/Multi-Buyer projections cannot persist
identity.clientGeneration: reject stale owner/source/workspace binding after switch/reload
identity.operationId: stable across retry for acknowledgement/replay idempotency
identity.rows: owner-scoped persisted row IDs with expected-existing/new distinction
identity.rowBases: existing row _rev CAS retained initially, including legacy zero
identity.structureBase: separate workspace revision only when schema/order/manufacturers/status structure changes
identity.ownerReplicaBase: opaque verified observed parent-head/lineage for future owner transport, not workspace revision alone

slot.path: allowlisted semantic persisted field or approved nested unit

operations.rowCreateDelete: explicit typed row existence operation, original order/ID and nextId semantics; no deletion inferred from unrelated missing rows
operations.group: one transaction includes shared parent state, linked materialized values, variant override presence and membership guard
operations.structure: typed schema/order/group structural command; sparse checkpoint allowed until affected closure is proved
coupledValues: note plus rich HTML and same-PLM non-overridden peers
pricing plus confirmation/current rule-derived fields through current semantic editor
period plus dependent dates preserving explicit Retail
group modelSharedValues/variantOverrides plus materialized row cells

copyAndNormalization.prepare: validate complete semantic unit before effects, copy changed mutable values/affected rows or group only
copyAndNormalization.untouched: preserve unknown persisted keys and read-only source references; no write through shared nested data
copyAndNormalization.normalize: load/migration and proved affected-group closure; unsupported structural units use explicit bounded checkpoint path
copyAndNormalization.source: existing immutable raw/worker source descriptor and owner/generation remain authoritative; no in-place mutation

localDurability.format: future versioned owner-bound command journal plus sparse checkpoint; final backend/schema undecided
localDurability.success: secured-local feedback only after recoverable journal commit; not equivalent to native fsync/server or remote publication
localDurability.migration: read existing pending schemas 1/2; preserve captured old bases/existence intent rather than rebasing by adoption
localDurability.coalescing: earliest before/latest after per unit with stable IDs; never discard newer in-flight local intent
localDurability.compaction: only after acknowledged operations/checkpoint durable boundary; limits and byte budget require explicit choice/evidence

undo.record: forward and inverse typed command per edit/group/paste with owner/base/dependency metadata and byte accounting
undo.apply: validate applicability/current after-state; retain remote unrelated fields; explicit conflict for same-field or membership change
undo.bulk: atomic primary Collection ACK before stack advancement; do not fabricate image/quotation atomic receipts
undo.fallback: sparse checkpoint for unproven structural commands, not 50 implicit full snapshots for ordinary cells

serverCompatibility.current: whole-row upserts/deletes over existing Collection PATCH with row _rev and structure CAS
serverCompatibility.initial: materialize only touched rows into legacy request contract; no new field-level concurrency policy
serverCompatibility.later: explicitly versioned field-patch adapter at current Collection route/save-worker; complete validation and live authority at commit
serverCompatibility.ack: per-operation applied/conflict/revision outcomes; partial HTTP200 respected; atomic:true remains all-or-none on validation conflict
serverCompatibility.legacy: full PUT and row PATCH remain supported during additive rollout

ownerTransport.namespace: permission-aware per-owner transport, never generic shared-collection delta pool
ownerTransport.future: small verified head + idempotent row/field deltas + ancestry-linked periodic checkpoints
preserve: three-way field conflicts with displaced intent retained
ownerTransport.status: local primary ACK and remote publication tracked separately

walAndChecklist.wal: reuse queuePatches/appendOperations; native batch tombstones need a real operation interface; success after common fsync
walAndChecklist.crashAtomicity: multi-line WAL crash replay requires proof/framing; one append does not prove atomic replay
walAndChecklist.checklist: new durable answers/pending-journal batch commit with one event/delta sync/render; preserve existing single-answer and legacy notification wrapper until converted
walAndChecklist.text: small durable dirty intent on input, 250-400ms expensive-work coalescing, blur/close/account flush
walAndChecklist.separateStores: no claimed atomic Collection/checklist/CP override commit; checklist server leased JSON is not local-db WAL
